description.p: Afterglow is a terminal built on Qt and Vulkan. Every pane of every window draws through one GPU device, with splits, tabs and a drop-down quick terminal.

ul.li: Kitty keyboard, graphics, text sizing, notification and clipboard protocols, and sixel images
Texture healing, ligatures and variable axes for fonts such as Monaspace
Custom shaders per pane and per window, animated splits, smooth scrolling and cursor motion
Program status, shell integration, hyperlinks and keyboard-driven URL opening
